question: What durations are allotted to the daily fire rite and daily festival?
premises: Daily rituals have fixed time allotments
The daily fire rite requires a set duration
The daily festival requires a set duration
inference: Half a unit is for the daily fire rite and two nāḍikās for the daily festival.
uncertainties: The exact unit of ardhaṃ is not specified in this verse
